response.sql:
WITH funding_counts AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS qc_count
  FROM scanqc AS q
  JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
)
SELECT fundflux,
       qc_count,
       1.0 * qc_count / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total,
       1.0 * qc_count / AVG(qc_count) OVER () AS relative_to_average
FROM funding_counts;

assumptions.assumption: A NULL fundflux is grouped as one funding-source group, as SQLite GROUP BY does by default.
